data.narrative:
ARX Robotics is a Series A-stage defense and security robotics company founded by Marc Wietfeld that has raised €42M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 peers—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private entities including Stark Defence, Singularity, NODA AI, Anduril Industries, and Helsing—all operating in the Defense & Security sector at similar development stages.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using the €42M total raised as a proxy for current value and applying a typical 2.0x step-up multiplier for progression to the next funding stage, yields €84M. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same-stage comparables—Stark Defence ($4.0B), Singularity ($400M), and NODA AI ($125M)—produces a median valuation of $400M, with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B. The wide peer dispersion reflects material heterogeneity in market positioning and investor sentiment within the Defense & Security space at Series A.

Triangulating these two methods produces a valuation range of $71M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $242M. The substantial gap between stage-progression and peer-median results reflects uncertainty regarding ARX's competitive positioning relative to better-capitalized peers. Key variables affecting the final valuation include technology differentiation, customer traction, team depth, and the trajectory of defense spending in ARX's target geographies.
